# Phynd Crm

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.
- `docs/ROADMAP.md` — canonical product/engineering phase map.
- `docs/MADFAM_TRUTH_LAYER_REMEDIATION.md` — executable gap-closure plan (WS0–WS9).
- `docs/SELVA_CRM_AGENT_TOOLS.md` — Selva service-token read tool manifest (WS6).
- `docs/CODEBASE_AND_PROD_EVIDENCE_2026-05-27.md` — latest codebase and
  production evidence snapshot.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.

## Pilot readiness scripts

- `pnpm pp5:pilot-ops` — operator checklist (automated gates + manual Enclii steps); add `--live` with `CRM_BASE_URL`
- `pnpm verify:pilot-go-live` — full pre-flight bundle (PP5 stability, migrations, staging audit, pilot readiness, post-deploy dry-run)
- `pnpm verify:post-deploy` — live deploy smoke after ArgoCD sync (`CRM_BASE_URL`; optional `--with-prod-auth`, `--with-selva-agent`)
- `pnpm db:migrate:tier` — verify migration artifacts (`--check-only`) or apply via `DATABASE_URL`
- `pnpm verify:prod-auth` — public sign-in URL hygiene on prod hosts
- `pnpm verify:migrations` — Tulana/SKU migration artifacts present through `0010`
- `pnpm verify:pilot-readiness` — bundles prod auth + migrations + PP5 webhook probe lanes + Selva probe
- `pnpm verify:janua-oidc` — Janua OIDC redirect URI checklist (Phase 0)
- Ops runbook: `docs/runbooks/PILOT_GO_LIVE.md`
